rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an action, plan, or amount has gone too far.

example.english: This plan has really gone overboard.
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gai3 waak6 zan1 hai6 gwo3 fo2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when something goes overboard and ends up in the sea, rather than merely outside the boat.

example.jyutping: go3 gau3 saang1 hyun1 dit3 zo2 lok6 hoi2

rows.note: Use this for throwing, dropping, or falling outside the boat when reaching the sea is not the point.

example.english: Someone accidentally threw the water bottle overboard.
example.traditional: 有人唔小心將個水樽掟出船外。
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 m4 siu2 sam1 zoeng1 go3 seoi2 zeon1 deng3 ceot1 syun4 ngoi6
